Serajul Huq with ABM Golam Majid and Anisul Huq, Advocates ------ For the Appellants.

parties:
Sarwar Kamal and others ------ Appellants
VS
State ------ Respondent
full_judgment: 8. PW 1 Badiur Rahman is the informant and he is the brother of the deceased victim Tajur Muluk. He has stated in his deposition that he along with his other 4 brothers, namely, Lokman Hakim, Haider Ali, Putan Ali and Tajur Muluk were ploughing in the case land, namely, plot Nos. 735, 736 and 776 of RS Khatian No. 1866 on Saturday at 9 a.m. on 25.7.81 for cultivation of ropa paddy, but accused Sarwar Kamal, Mir Kashem, Darbesh Ali, Noor Ahmed, Sona Ali, Putiakabli, Kala Miah, Sekandar Fakir, Abul Hossain, Motaleb, Siraj Ahmed, Faiz Ahmed, Eunus, Ejahar Ali and Nurul Huq gheraoed them and at the order of accused Sarwar Kamal accused Mir Kashem with a dao in his hand gave a blow (kope) on the head of the victim Tajur Muluk and accused Darbesh Ali also gave dao blow on the back of Tajur Muluk and accused Seraj Ahmed by a dao blow cut off one left hand finger of Faiza Khatoon, PW 5, wife of the deceased victim Tajur Muluk, when she rushed to the place of occurrence; that accused Sekander Fakir assaulted Lokman by a lathi. On receiving the blows, the victim Tajur Muluk fell down on the ground. The accused persons filed away when a member of the Union Parishad Mohammad Hossain and one Subeder of the BDR and others came to the place of occurrence; that the informant PW 1 was also attacked by the accused but he fled away in the house of one Jalal member to save himself. He further stated that accused Sarwar Kamal and Mir Kashem thereafter set fire on the house of one Hossain Ali of the complainant party. The injured persons particularly victim Tajur Muluk and Faiza Khatoon were taken to the Teknaf Hospital and thereafter noticing their further deteriorating condition, the informant and Kashem Ali PW 6 took the victim to the Cox's Bazar Hospital for treatment. Meanwhile PW 1 went to the Teknaf Police-station and lodged and ejahar. The condition of the injured persons having further deteriorated, particularly the condition of the victim Tajur Muluk being very critical he was shifted to the Dulahajara Hospital where he ultimately succumbed to his injuries after 3 days of the occurrence. He has further stated that the case lands are in their possession on the basis of their purchase from the father of accused Sarwar Kamal; that the case lands belong to the informant and his 4 other brothers. He proved the First Information Report and his signature in the First Information Report. In cross examination this witness has stated that the eye witnesses of the occurrence are his relations and that Plot Nos 735 and 736 are in the same place. He has further stated that another plot is situated on the southern side of the Goda canal and the distance of both the plots is about 10 bamboos, In the west of the case land is Ali Akbor Para but there is no witness from that para. He has stated further in cross examination that they have houses by the side of the case land and there are 20/25 houses to the north east side of his house and there is no witness from those houses. He has also denied the suggestion that the case land belongs to one Dhala Bibi, mother of some accuseds. He has also denied the suggestion that the said Dhala Bibi obtained a decree in respect of the case-land with permanent injunction in her favour. He has further stated that they filed a suit for setting aside the said decree and denied the suggestion that the said suit was dismissed on 5.8.67 and asserted that the said suit was decreed. He has also denied the suggestion that the Misc. case for retrial also was rejected and he could not remember whether the plaintiff instituted as No. 265 of 1969 and the suit was found to be incompetent by court's order dated 7.9.79. He further denied the suggestion that the appeal against that order also abated and the case lands were attached in a proceeding, namely, NGR 80 of 1981 under section 145 of the Code of criminal Procedure. He denied a suggestion that the accused possessed the case-lands but he could not remember what happened in the appeal before the Judge's Court. He stated that he had heard that there was a stay order which was passed by the High Court. He further states that he deposed in the judicial enquiry and it is not correct that his evidence does not tally with the ejahar. He further states in his cross-examination that the accuseds are very powerful persons and that is why any independent witness did not agree to depose. He could not remember whether finger cutting of Faiza Khatun was mentioned in the ejahar. He admits that due to hurry he could not state all details in the ejhar. He has asserted that he has not stated anything false in the ejahar. He further states that the dropping of the names of accused Sarwar Kamal and other two persons in the charge-sheet led to the subsequent judicial inquiry. He further states that he did not find accused Sarwar and Mr Kashem in the thana at the time of lodging the ejahar; that accused Darbesh Ali was a member of the Union Parishad; he denied a suggestion that at the time of occurrence, accused Darbesh Ali was present in the court of SDO Cox's Bazar in connection with CR 535 of 1981 and that the distance of the office of the SDO Cox's Bazar from the place of occurrence is 50 miles. In answer to another suggestion he could not say whether the accused No. 17 Naigobali was in Saudi Arabia at that time; he has denied another suggestion that the accused Sarwar Kamal's relations have been falsely implicated in this case out of enmity. He denied further suggestion that they tresspassed into the case land and assaulted the men of cultivation of accused Sarwar Kamal. He denied the suggestion that he formed an unlawful assembly with 12 persons. He also denied the suggestion that he and others tresspassed into the land of Dhala Bibi. He denied the suggestion that the accuseds possessed the case lands. He denied the suggestion that he and others have seriously assaulted the men of the accused party. Lastly, he denied the suggestion that in order to save himself from the said case of assault, he has filed this false case. He further denied the suggestion that the occurrence did not happen at the place, time and in the manner as alleged by the prosecution.
